title: Structural insight into dynamic switching mechanism of the SAM-IV riboswitch revealed by molecular simulations
task: Characterize SAM-IV riboswitch conformational dynamics and ligand-binding mechanism
key_results: SAM-bound state exhibits restricted ensemble with lower local fluctuations; apo state samples broader conformational variability with redistributed tertiary contacts; MM-GBSA favors ligand stabilization in native bound state
comments: 32 µs aggregate MD provides substantial sampling, but authors appropriately acknowledge that the ensemble-based switching model remains a simulation-derived hypothesis requiring experimental kinetic validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SAM binding stabilizes a restricted subset of riboswitch conformations
hypotheses.result: Supported: SAM-bound state shows lower fluctuations and favorable MM-GBSA scores; apo state samples broader ensemble

hypotheses.hypothesis: Apo conformations retain capacity to bind SAM despite increased flexibility
hypotheses.result: Partially supported by ensemble docking, but with lower scoring and energetic resolution limitations

title: Experimental limitations introduced during cluster analysis in super-resolution microscopy due to the choice of labeling methods and fluorophores
task: Quantify labeling-induced errors in super-resolution microscopy nanocluster quantification
key_results: Antibody-based dSTORM shows ~42% quantification error relative to PALM; error decreases with smaller probes or monovalent nanobodies
comments: Systematic benchmarking against FAK clusters is valuable, though the ~42% error magnitude suggests dSTORM's current limitations for high-precision cluster analysis warrant careful consideration in biological applications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Antibody-based labeling introduces larger quantification errors than smaller probes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: antibody dSTORM shows ~42% error; smaller probes and monovalent nanobodies reduce error

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiple labeling factors (clonality, fluorophore number, steric hindrance, blinking) systematically affect nanocluster quantification
hypotheses.result: Supported: systematic characterization identifies linkage error as critical contributor to size quantification bias

title: G3BP1-induced retrograde transport blockade triggers HSC activation and liver fibrosis via COPI alternative splicing
task: Identify molecular mechanisms of hepatic stellate cell activation and liver fibrogenesis
key_results: G3BP1 upregulation in fibrotic livers; G3BP1 ablation attenuates HSC activation and fibrotic progression; G3BP1 promotes COPI alternative splicing via SRPK1-mediated hnRNPM phosphorylation, triggering ER stress
comments: Novel non-stress-granule function for G3BP1 in HSC biology provides a potentially druggable axis for fibrosis therapy.

model_io.model: Human LX-2 HSCs and primary mouse HSCs

hypotheses.hypothesis: G3BP1 upregulation drives HSC activation independently of stress granules
hypotheses.result: G3BP1 promotes activation in cultured HSCs and fibrosis models via COPI splicing, not SG-dependent mechanisms

hypotheses.hypothesis: G3BP1 regulates COPI subunit alternative splicing through hnRNPM interaction
hypotheses.result: SRPK1-phosphorylated hnRNPM recruits G3BP1 to promote COPG1 exon 2 and COPB2 exon 8 skipping

title: Single-cell transcriptomic profiling reveals novel stem cell markers for corneal limbal epithelium homeostasis
task: Identify novel stem cell markers for corneal limbal epithelium homeostasis
key_results: scRNA-seq of 20,351 cells identified 13 clusters; Gabrp, Fmo1, Fmo2, Alcam associated with stemness pathways; Gabrp and Alcam exclusively expressed in limbus by qPCR and immunofluorescence
comments: Comprehensive transcriptomic profiling establishes a solid reference atlas, though functional validation of proposed markers in LSC maintenance remains pending.

model_io.model: Sox9-EGFP transgenic mouse corneal limbal epithelium

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sox9-EGFP marks limbal stem cells and correlates with stemness-related gene expression
hypotheses.result: EGFP-enriched cluster exhibited elevated Gabrp, Fmo1, Fmo2, Alcam associated with stemness pathways

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gabrp and Alcam are limbus-specific markers of LSCs
hypotheses.result: Both genes showed exclusive limbal expression by qPCR, Western blot, and immunofluorescence versus central cornea

title: Photocrosslinked gelatin hydrogel-mediated IGF-1 delivery promotes early cartilage-like tissue formation in a rabbit auricular defect model
task: Promote cartilage repair in auricular defects using growth factor-loaded biomaterial
key_results: IGF-1-loaded hydrogel achieved 83.8% defect coverage with cartilage-like tissue versus 6.4% for hydrogel alone; sustained IGF-1 retention over 14 days in vivo; elevated COL2A1, ACAN, SOX9 expression and increased angiogenesis without calcification
comments: Strong proof-of-concept for growth factor delivery via photocrosslinked hydrogel, though long-term mechanical maturation and durability remain uncharacterized.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Photocrosslinked gelatin hydrogel prolongs local IGF-1 retention compared to solution
hypotheses.result: Fluorescence imaging confirmed sustained IGF-1 release from hydrogel over 14 days versus rapid diffusion of free IGF-1

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sustained IGF-1 delivery promotes chondrocyte proliferation and chondrogenesis in defects
hypotheses.result: IGF-1-loaded hydrogel generated 83.8% cartilage-like tissue coverage with elevated chondrogenic gene expression and angiogenesis

title: Large language model surrogates for Bayesian optimization of antibody sequences
task: Optimize antibody sequences via Bayesian optimization with LLM surrogates
key_results: AbL2BO achieved superior sample efficiency and better-calibrated uncertainty estimates compared to Gaussian process-based BO across benchmark datasets
comments: Clever use of LLM as surrogate model bypasses kernel design challenges but requires validation on real wet-lab antibody campaigns to demonstrate clinical utility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM surrogates provide better sample efficiency than kernel-based BO for sequence optimization
hypotheses.result: Supported; AbL2BO outperformed conventional BO methods

title: Assessing model transferability to predict the state of battery health across independent datasets
task: Evaluate zero-shot transfer of battery health forecasting models across datasets
key_results: Transfer error depended primarily on target domain degradation regularity, not distributional distance; persistence baseline outperformed learned models on many transfers; MC Dropout intervals often 10× wider than actual error
comments: Important methodological contribution showing that standard transfer assumptions fail for prognostics; highlights need for domain-aware reference baselines in cross-dataset benchmarks.

model_io.model: Six forecasting models (linear regression to RNN/attention networks)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dataset distributional distance (MMD/AUC) predicts transfer error
hypotheses.result: Refuted; pair with largest distance showed easiest transfer

hypotheses.hypothesis: Target domain degradation regularity enables transfer
hypotheses.result: Supported; most regular dataset (ZHU) had lowest transfer error for all models

title: Physics-informed neural surrogate learning predicts cervical cancer progression with mechanistic interpretability
task: Predict cervical cancer progression via physics-informed neural surrogate learning
key_results: PI-NSL achieved time-dependent AUC 0.91±0.03 for 2-year PFS prediction, C-index 0.89±0.04 on internal test; external validation at two Indian institutions: AUC 0.87±0.05 and 0.86±0.05; unsupervised clustering identified three clinically distinct phenotypes with significantly different survival (log-rank p<0.001)
comments: Novel hybrid approach combining mechanistic PDE constraints with neural networks is scientifically elegant and achieves strong generalization; identified clusters warrant prospective mechanistic validation but represent clinically actionable stratification.

model_io.model: PI-NSL (variational PDE encoder + differentiable PDE solver + risk operator)
inputs: routine clinical data from 20,287 cervical cancer patients

hypotheses.hypothesis: Soft PDE constraints improve mechanistic interpretability without sacrificing predictive accuracy
hypotheses.result: Supported; model achieved AUC 0.91 with clinically meaningful latent clusters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Three distinct immune-tumor phenotypes emerge from unsupervised latent analysis
hypotheses.result: Supported; clusters show high immune activity (84% 2-yr PFS), peripheral accumulation (45%), and high proliferation (28%)

title: Transcriptional responses of white-tailed deer to SARS-CoV-2 challenge
task: Characterize temporal host transcriptional response to SARS-CoV-2 in white-tailed deer
key_results: Deer mounted regulated antiviral response with interferon/cytokine pathways activated by day 2 pi, followed by cytokine storm inhibition by day 5 pi; 22 conserved upregulated genes at day 2 across deer/elk/bison (including ADAR, STAT1); only 25 genes conserved at day 5, indicating species-divergent responses
comments: Well-designed longitudinal study clarifies temporal immune architecture in susceptible host; species comparison highlights lack of conserved adaptive responses, consistent with ecological observations of differential infection susceptibility.

inputs: whole blood from experimentally infected deer (days 0, 2, 5, 7 pi)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deer exhibit rapid innate immune activation followed by regulatory phase
hypotheses.result: Supported; strong day-2 interferon response with day-5 cytokine storm suppression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Antiviral defense mechanisms are conserved across deer/elk/bison
hypotheses.result: Partially supported; 22 genes conserved at day 2 but only 25 at day 5; lack of shared adaptive response

title: Region-aware CT-to-PET image synthesis using deep learning models for accurate lung cancer localization
task: Synthesize functional PET from anatomical CT for lung cancer localization
key_results: Four-stage pipeline: YOLOv11 thorax detection (mAP50 99.50% CT/98.50% PET), ResNet-9 patchGAN 18F-FDG synthesis (PSNR 20.94 dB, SSIM 72.94%), SegResNet tumor segmentation (Dice 97.06%, IoU 93.65%), with tumor superimposition boosting synthesis metrics within tumor regions (SSIM 83.47%, PSNR 25.99 dB)
comments: Practical CAD system with modular architecture showing strong technical performance; tumor-aware enhancement is clever, but clinical validation on diagnostic accuracy vs. real PET remains absent.

model_io.model: Four-stage pipeline: YOLOv11 + CPGAN + SegResNet + fusion

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tumor-aware synthesis improves PET quality in metabolically active regions
hypotheses.result: Supported; tumor superimposition increased SSIM to 83.47% vs. 72.94% baseline

title: Machine learning analysis of serum ATR-FTIR spectra for colorectal cancer discrimination
task: Discriminate colorectal cancer from controls using serum ATR-FTIR and machine learning
key_results: PCA-ANN model achieved 87.5% accuracy, 90.0% sensitivity, 85.0% specificity, AUC 0.941 internally; external validation on 28 subjects: 85.7% accuracy, AUC 0.920
comments: Reasonable proof-of-concept on small cohorts with interpretable spectral biomarkers (protein, phosphate, carbohydrate), but external sample size is very limited and demographic balance not addressed.

inputs: ATR-FTIR spectra (100 CRC + 100 controls, dried serum)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Serum ATR-FTIR spectra contain discriminant signals for CRC detection
hypotheses.result: Supported; model achieved 87.5% accuracy with high sensitivity/specificity

title: An integrated multimodal neural network framework for early diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease and mild cognitive impairment combining genomic, neuroimaging, and behavioral modalities
task: Early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment via multimodal deep learning
key_results: Integrated 3D-CNN (MRI) + dense network (genomics) + RNN (behavioral) model exceeded unimodal baselines; attention-gating mechanism provided interpretable biomarker identification for early AD/MCI detection
comments: Well-motivated architecture design but abstract lacks concrete performance metrics (accuracy/AUC/cohort sizes), making it difficult to assess real clinical utility.

inputs: behavioral/cognitive measurements from ADNI + UK Biobank

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multimodal integration improves early AD/MCI detection vs. unimodal approaches

title: A label-free domain-knowledge-informed framework for transferability evaluation of synthetic accessibility scoring in energetic chemical space
task: Transferability evaluation of synthetic accessibility scoring for energetic materials
key_results: Label-free domain-knowledge framework evaluated eight SA models across 28,195 candidate molecules; SAscore and BR-SAScore show most consistent transferability; heteroatom-rich linkages with moderate scaffold complexity identified as pivotal for high-energy-density materials
comments: Unsupervised evaluation framework is creative for data-scarce domains; however, lack of labeled ground truth limits validation rigor—domain-knowledge constraints alone may not fully substitute for empirical validation.

model_io.model: Eight synthetic accessibility scoring models (SAscore, BR-SAScore, etc.)
inputs: molecular structures in energetic chemical space (28,195 candidates)

task: Complete-coverage path planning for autonomous vehicles and USVs
key_results: CCPP-LPC algorithm achieves best performance in path length and repeated coverage ratio across four grid maps; adaptive dual-guided perturbation improves convergence speed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Local path cost evaluation and adaptive dual-guided perturbation improve convergence and path quality in CCPP

title: Traffic signs recognition for advanced driver assistance systems using deep learning

comments: Comprehensive architecture comparison across CNNs, detection, and transformers is valuable; however, evaluation limited to single GTSRB dataset—multi-dataset robustness and real-world ADAS field testing needed before deployment claims.

ensemble arrival picks with improved reliability
